final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), step2 AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) / CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS REAL) as ratio FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.account_id, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.ratio as excess FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.ratio IS NOT NULL AND s1.cnt > s2.ratio), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.account_id, s3.cnt, s3.excess, s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt as delta FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT account_id, cnt, excess, delta FROM step5
